chunks: 3187 - And the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, said:
"A part of me will be buried in Khurasan. No distressed person visits her except that Allah, Mighty and Exalted, relieves his distress, and no sinner except that Allah forgives his sins."

key_terms.بَضْعَةٌ: a part or piece of me, indicating a close sacred relation
key_terms.بِخُرَاسَانَ: in Khurasan, the place of burial mentioned in the hadith
key_terms.مَكْرُوبٌ: one afflicted by distress or grief

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for visiting the one buried in Khurasan mentioned by the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله?
ai.summary: The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله foretells that one who is a part of him will be buried in Khurasan, and that visiting her is a means of divine mercy. The hadith highlights the spiritual merit of ziyārah through relief from distress and forgiveness of sins.
